question:
Select the set in which the given numbers are related to each other in the same way as the numbers in the given set in the question are related to each other. (Note: Mathematical operations should be performed on whole numbers only, without dividing the number into its component digits. Like 13 - Suppose mathematical operations on 13 like adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. can be done on 13. Breaking into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(6, 9, 2) (12, 36, 2)
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (1st number ÷ 3rd number)² = 2nd number.

Now,

For, 6 : 9 : 2

⇒ (6 ÷ 2)² = 3² = 9.

For, 12 : 36 : 2

⇒ (12 ÷ 2)² = 6² = 36.
